justification: Page is the genuine JLL listing 'reTOUCH ULTRA RIMLESS 3 GANG 1 WAY 16A SWITCHES' and its description quotes 'WHITE : M031W', matching the display_name model. However, the asset is a shared tri-variant family hero banner showing white, texture gold AND matte grey plates together with JLL/ReTouch logos and warranty callout boxes, so it cannot be pinned to the named white (M031W) variant alone.

HSL page is titled 'WYNN'S W0283 MODULAR PLUG CRIMPING TOOL' and description quotes 'Wynns W0283 200mm (8") Modular Plug Crimping Tool', matching item_code tail W0283 and display_name. Image shows the actual tool with 'WYNN'S W0283 200mm' printed on its body; no colour/finish is named in display_name.

Tiam Heng page is titled 'WYNN'S W09 MINI BOLT CUTTER 8"/200MM' with 'Item #: W09', matching display_name's W09 and 200MM (page notes Sold Out but is otherwise a real product page). Image depicts the green/black W09 mini bolt cutter with Wynn's logo and 'W09 (MINI) BOLT CUTTER' caption; no colour variant is named in display_name.

LKK Hardware page title is 'SAMA AC15S CERAMIC S-TRAP' (RM35, in stock), quoting AC15S as in display_name. The image is the same CDN file used as the page's main product photo and shows an actual beige ceramic S-trap labelled 'CERAMIC S-TRAP'; display_name names no colour/finish.

Rowy page 'uPVC Reducing Socket Fitting 50MM - 100MM Grade BBB' lists connection size '3" X 2" 82MM X 50MM', matching item_code tail 82X50MM and display_name '3 X 2'. Image is a clean photo of exactly this generic white uPVC reducing socket sold under this listing; no visual contradiction with the named size.

Official Fuji Electric page for SC-N2S (新SC・NEO SCシリーズ magnetic contactor) quotes 'SC-N2S' with rated current 50A, matching display_name 'SC-N2S Contertor'; the image is Fuji's own reference photo (/products/magnetic_contactor/sc/scn2s/scn2s.jpg) showing the contactor faceplate marked SC-N2S [50]. No colour/size variant is named beyond the model itself.
